Direct integration of reviewed follow-up commits was authorized by the maintainer to avoid duplicate full CI. Preliminary C3 No-root Home 1.9.3 / Helper 0.7.4 passed immediate physical Home, moving packaged UHD wallpaper, persistence beyond 120 seconds, app-switch media suspension/resume and triple-Home emergency return to LG. These preliminary artifacts do not replace final selected candidate evidence. Full candidate build/run selection, exact Helper compatibility with published Home, coherent signed Root acceptance, sound, standby, cold boot, supported OTA and rollback remain pending. Details: docs/history/2026-11-05-single-home-regressions.md. No stable publication or main merge before mandatory candidate gates.
